notes.title: Newspapers Stand + Weather Part I
notes.content:
Hello! This update introduces a newspaper stand in front of the store which will display several interesting information. Also a weather system is being slowly introduced and it is still in an early phase: will start affecting small aspects of the gameplay in next update like customers wanting more cold drinks in Summer and introduce several visual effects, like affecting sun light. More details below.

Changelog:
- Implemented a new place in front of the supermarket: the Newspapers Stand. Apart from providing information in the future about certain city events, a calendar and weather’s data can already be visualized. Seasons are split in 4 28-days periods for now as having real 365 days terms could be too much.

- Added a new perk: Persuasion Techniques.

- Implemented a small rain and snow falling effect in their respective weather days. They should be more often in autumn and winter. In next update good weather days will attract a few more extra customers as opposed to bad weather which will attract less, in exchange there could be more online orders (the current overall number of customers visiting the store won’t be affected). Visual effects depend on player graphic settings (lowest shouldn’t see any).

- Added two achievements related to the fire extinguisher and the new perk.

- Added 15 additional exotic materials to the paintables tablet ones.

- Fixed an issue in which dropping the fire extinguisher would make its smoke suddenly disappear.

- Fixed an issue in which the wrong storename would appear in the ‘Latest Autosave’ field when changing save files.

notes.title: Where's The Fire?
notes.content:
Where’s the fire? For now nowhere. But… feeling your friend needs an extra incentive to work faster? Did that oblivious customer got stuck somehow on a spot and you are feeling helpless to help him? Thinking that thief deserves something more than a good broomin’? Your faithful extinguisher comes to the rescue, now available in the devices tab for a modest price.

Having introduced these kind of fire security assets may open the door for related events or even the necessity of comply with certain local safety laws?

[Changelog]
- Alien event has been deactivated until their next unexpected visit. The suspicious looking antenna is not available anymore, already placed ones will stay but will do nothing.

- Implemented two new perks: Recruitment I & II. Each giving one employee hire reroll per day.

- Implemented a new prop under the devices tab: the fire extinguisher. Pushing NPCs around is experimental and it will have to be checked if it introduces problems with their navigation.

- Implemented 6 additional decorations related to fire extinguish and detection: more extinguishers, hoses, alarms, smoke detectors…

- Autosave now remembers spawned trash during the day and shouldn’t create a bunch of them when loading the game at advanced hours.

- Some systems are having trouble trying to play an announcement in the corresponding desk hence not being able to get the related achievement. The achievement has been changed and will trigger by only having a desk placed at the end of the day instead.

- Made significant improvements to the autosave behaviour stability. (Uploaded as hotfix)

- Implemented a backup button in the debug menu (Shift + F6 in main menu) to try to recover affected saves by an autosaving bug that seemed to affect some systems. It should at least recover the previous day before the last played. (Uploaded as hotfix)

notes.title: Extra Lights + Limited Autosave + Fixes
notes.content:
Small patch this week but implements a first iteration of a feature that has been asked in forums, private messages, email, event comments, Reddit, Twitter, etc.: Autosaving. Hopefully that demand is now closed (but feel free to comment on how to improve it or report any malfunction). At least players won’t lose entire hours of progress if p.e. they spend two hours remodeling and painting their store and the game crashes.

The actual implementation doesn’t save for now:
- Several details like if the ordering department is opened. To be fixed for next week.
- Boxes left on floor. Might be fixed for next week and -might- consider if they are also saved when ending the day too.
- NPCs and employees positions and chores. Viability of this is being studied as there are plenty of values to save and synchronize per entity.
- Some other small details to be addressed like closed checkouts lanes.


Changelog:
- Added 10 new oriental-themed lights.

- Implemented a ‘beta’ feature of Autosaving and Save and Quit. Autosaving is disabled by default and can be enabled in the load store menu and time can be chosen ranging from an interval of 5 minutes to 30 minutes. Save and quit button is available for hosts while in escape menu. Once a save has been generated either from autosave or save and quit, the option to continue will appear in a new tab in the Load Store menu right side.

- Optimized and merged textures from products nº87 to 116.

- Fixed an issue in which ordering employees wouldn’t earn experience (was awarded to restocker instead). A reminder that employees in the ordering role will add an additional product to their orders for every two levels.

- The big red icon that appears over a furniture when it breaks should now correctly disappear if that furniture is sold or move accordingly if the furniture has been displaced.

- Corrected Human Resources perk cost showing 6 instead of 5 (5 is the correct number even if it unlocks 6 employees)

- Optimized and reduced the size of some of the NPCs secondary textures. The visual loss is almost negligible.

- Removed some props belonging to the city that were out-of-sight for a tiny performance gain.

notes.title: Packaging Employee Role
notes.content:
Small routine patch: employees can now be reassigned to a first iteration of the order packaging role. Earning experience in packaging will make them move faster in that role and add an extra bonus product to the order per two levels up to a cap.

Changelog:
- Employees can now be assigned to Order Packaging. Employees won’t use tables but for now will instead roam around taking items in their order box and carrying them to placed pickup points so ordering tables are left free for players. If possible they will always prioritize taking products from storage, then store.

- Implemented three new statistics/leveling for employees: technician, ordering and manufacturing. Manufacturing isn’t implemented yet but it was something very convenient to do now.

- Modified the employee’s tab interface to reflect all the changes above: a new bar of stars for each new competence. Already hired employees new values (technician, ordering and manufacturing) will be an average value calculated considering the old levels: cashier, restock, storage and security.

- Cashier employees will now check out several products at a time depending on their level. They incrementally earn experience slower from now on though.

- Due to the new addition of the technician role, furniture and devices can now also break in difficulty 0. There should be an average of 2 broken devices per day on difficulty 0 up to around 8-10 on difficulty 10. Earning experience will make technicians move and repair faster.

- Fixed not being able to be place lights on the ceiling of the Order Packaging department.

- Fixed NPCs yelling twice when slipping over a patch of water.

notes.title: Technician Employees
notes.content:
Hello! Employees now have a new role. Some pre-steps have been implemented to allow employees to also be assigned to Order Packaging so that will probably arrive next patch.

Changelog:
- Implemented a new role for employees: Technician. Technicians will fix stuff broken around the store and will help carrying cardboard bales to the trash spot. Storage crew no longer recycle bales. For now there’s no experience gaining and leveling associated to the technician role but there will be.

- Introduced a new type of fixing case: fridges and freezers now enter the pool of furniture that can break and will create a water puddle which makes NPCs slip and fall. If a player steps on a water puddle while running they will slip similar to when receiving a broom hit.

- Implemented two new achievements related to repairing. First one is per-player and only requires one repair, second one can be shared between players and employees count too. Also a new statistic related to how many devices have been repaired now exists.

- The same piece of furniture or device cannot break twice the same day from now on.

- Added an animated wrench as a visual effect when fixing anything.

- Customers getting in line of sight shouldn’t interrupt fixing progress anymore. Not applied to placing products or pricing yet as that requires completely rewriting something else.

- Items already inside the table’s packing box in Order Packaging will now be substracted from the blue tray’s tablet list. Note this is for now a per-player local feature, items added by other players won’t get substracted.

- Improved the breaking control behaviour and there shouldn’t be more cases of floating symbols in the store’s entrance.

- Fixed a small general problem in the perks blackboard that made some perks visually require one single previous upgrade but actually required more.

- Fixed an issue in which if another player carried a toolbox, the rest could fix repair events even without holding a toolbox themselves.

Known issue: customers complain twice while slipping, one of those complaints being irrevelant as it is the same type of complain as with being hit with the broom and will be removed.

notes.title: Order Packaging Fixes
notes.content:

- Fixed an issue in which employees wouldn’t be able to enter the new department.

notes.title: Order Packaging + Discord
notes.content:
Hello! Today’s update features the first iteration of a department. As always remember there could be some problems not found during testings and many changes and improvements during the incoming days will depend on player’s feedback. Ideas to make the box packing more compelling are welcomed.

notes.title: Ceiling Beams, Achievements, Fixes
notes.content:
Today’s update features new achievements and the requested introduction of several types of paintable beams shapes. Please take a look at the new experimental function only present in the architectural tab: pressing [Drop Item] will make pillars, walls or other elements ignore collisions. Use this feature for decorating with caution.

Work is continuing regarding the introduction of purple departments. Some of you may be impatient for the order packaging update and it may be delayed to coincide with a major game event. Thanks for your patience.

Changelog:
- Implemented four paintable ceiling beams basic types as decoration in the architectural tab.

- Holding [Drop Item] while placing architectural elements with the builder tab will now make the placed element ignore all collisions. Players can use this for placing p.e. a pillar in a wall or merging a wall module in an intersection. Be careful not to place these elements in furniture’s red areas as it could create soft conflicts.

- Cardboard baler now has an animation when used.

	* Recycling 40 cardboard bales.

- Statistics menu in the manager’s blackboard now reflects some of the values related to the achievements above.

- Customers should take items from top to bottom shelves’ rows instead of doing the current opposite.

- Debris dust when demolishing a pillar or beam will only appear in high performance mode. Some players have reported slowdowns in the lowest graphic settings.

- Updated some icons in the architectural tab with better versions.

- Added the word ‘Drink’ to red, green and black tea bottles so they don’t get confused with infusions with the same name.

- All security employees should now help with picking ground products if no customers left and during night closing hours.

notes.title: Cardboard Baler Update
notes.content:
Hello! Let’s welcome a new friendly device called the Cardboard Baler: it should save trips to the trash spots for both players and employees.

Changelog:
- Implemented a new device: the Cardboard Baler. These can be placed anywhere in the storage and when players or employees deposit 10 empty boxes in them, a cardboard bale will be returned. Bales can be recycled for their equivalent in funds. Restockers will use the closest one to their positions and the storage crew will be the responsible to detect and carry bales if they haven’t got anything else to do.

- Fixed an issue in which supermarket letters would always glow green independently of chosen color after loading the game.

- Implemented two new option settings: being able to disable offensive NPCs comments and being able to set camera’s FOV while in blackboard events. Players with a different screen aspect ratio may find this last option useful so everything fits their screen.

- Images’ borders in picture frames should now adjust to the edges correctly.

- Staffroom’s jail corner and the jail itself can now be painted.

- Fixed a critical issue related to one product (gaming console) with wrong data assigned. Some scripts interacting with it could cause rare crashing or just plain errors.

- Fixed some colliders in the main scene being negative (interactions sometimes would return spammy messages in logs).

- Fixed an obscure issue in which there would be a small chance a customer with a custom shopping list would do literally no shopping due to an error in the randomness of the behavior.

- Extra advancements have been done (and also undone) regarding Order Packaging. Gameplay decisions are still being considered.

notes.title: Products On Sale + Improved Shopping Lists
notes.content:
Hello! Patch mainly features being able to put products on sale and corrected shopping lists. System is fresh and still has flaws so suggestions are welcomed for its improvement. Feel free to also suggest more shopping list variations.

Changelog:
- Implemented a first iteration for putting products on sale. Players can use the new tablet and labels in the manager’s blackboard to set daily sales. Customers will have a chance to add an item on sale to their shopping list depending on the set discount and the base product’s price, so p.e. an expensive electronic item on sale shouldn’t get that much success compared to a basic good. 

- Added 3 new perks in the upgrade’s blackboard which increase allowed amount of daily products on sale.

- Implemented the chance of compensated shopping lists for customers. Note plenty of them will still restrict themselves to their usual behaviour. Examples of implemented shopping lists are:
	* Party: will buy drinks, alcohol and snacks.
	* Customers in a hurry which will only buy food like some quick sushi and some drinks.
	* Some will restrict themselves to gardening, cheap electronics, filling a medkit with pharmacy products or needing baby products.
	* There’s a very rare chance of unique customers like toilet paper hoarders or the only-buying-salt guy.
	For example, a young person will have bigger chances to buy snacks and alcohol for a party than an aged one, which may be looking for basics. Compensated shopping lists are more apparent as an store progresses.

- Related to camera’s minigame, customers getting in line of sight of the being-analyzed person shouldn’t reset the current progress.

- Sliced bread has been re-textured to match the same shader as other products. This is a pre-step for future product optimizations.

- Copying game’s logs is now done a bit diferently due to some players reporting its malfunction in some cases. Main button now divides into primary logs and secondary logs.

- TVs and CCTV cameras can now be placed in almost any surface including paintable wall modules.

- Fixed an issue in which replacing one product with another on a shelf wouldn’t update the corresponding price label.

notes.title: Picture Frame Decoration + Fixes
notes.content:
Hello! This patch implements a very requested decoration: a wall frame players can place and choose from different stock pictures. Cosmetic DLC owners can also choose images from the net. Work continues on other fronts.

Changelog:
- Implemented a new decoration: the painting frame. Players can choose between 50 stock pictures and owners of the cosmetic DLC can type valid URLs for syncing images on the net. URLs are not allowed in stores with public visibility. Players can also choose the canvas dimensions.

- Implemented a new Star Perk: Logistics. Players acquiring it will be able to have a visual cue on a product’s position either in store or storage when holding a box of that product. This perk is not located at the end of any tree but relatively close to start.

- The number of lights players can have in their store has been limited to 240. Due to some players sharing logs it has been found that having too many lights can cause cases of black screens in certain graphic’s qualities. A counter in the builder’s lighting tab reflects the current number of placed lights. Further testings will be done and a toggle will be added in case players want to explore decoration without this restriction as it may be hardware or system dependant or other unknown reasons.

- The three closest streetlights to the store have been removed so players can build there their own. Also building bounds has been slightly extended towards the street.

- Modified certain properties of the corner shelves so they snap correctly but players might see their positions moderately offsetted if already placed. Sorry for this inconvenience.

- Contents in the tray should be visually synced when another player is carrying it. This feature is still experimental and could need some tweaks.

- Clicking a trash container while carrying a tray will empty it of its contents.

- Fixed long types of ice creams overlapping in the new tray item.

- Fixed an issue in which cross and T paintable modules would appear visually bugged when rotated at 45º degrees.

notes.content:
New patch is here! Hope you enjoyed free electricity and rents because it’s time to pay for them.

Changelog:
- Implemented a first iteration of an invoice and loan/debt system. The invoice tab is now active in the manager’s blackboard featuring loans request and the payment of 4 possible types of invoices:
	* A rent invoice generated every 7 days, its amount depending on the number of store and storage purchased slots.
	* An electric invoice generated daily which depends on the number of electrical devices present in the store.

notes.title: Ordering Device + Employee's Rework
notes.content:
Hello! Following the rework done to employees, today’s patch features some changes that make them more efficient in addition to more fixes and a new hand device. 
A small issue in which employees would sometimes drop their box while finishing restocking is being investigated, it may have to do with the new time acceleration perk.

Changelog:

- Winter event has been removed.

- Implemented a new device requested by the community: the ordering device. It allows players to order products by clicking on shelves in store or spots in storage and its shopping list is shared with the one in the manager’s blackboard. Six physical devices can be found below the perks blackboard. Controls:
	* Right click to add the selected product box from the shopping list.
	* Left click to subtract the selected product box from the shopping list.
	* Build (E or assigned key) to buy the cargo.

- Related to previous, MART OS 2.0. star perk will make the new ordering device show useful additional info like how many products of a certain type you have in store (in boxes too) or how many boxes you need to fill the store. If players add up both values, they will know how many boxes of a certain product they need in order to fill their store and hence managing their stock in a much better way.

- Rewrote part of the restocker code in a more efficient way, the freezes that occurred when employees were assigned to restock but there was nothing to do should be gone. 

- Rewrote part of the storage manager code, employees dedicated to it should prioritize storage in the following way:
	* First: labeled shelf that matches the product. From closest to the manager’s room to the farthest.
	* Second: Any unlabeled shelf. From closest to the farthest.
	* Third: labeled shelf with any unassigned spot. From closest to the farthest.

- Employees dedicated to storage managing should now merge boxes if possible. Also improved this behavior for restockers.

- The cases where employees would take the same task at the same time should happen less often now.

- Players should now be able to change names of hired employees when clicking on their names in the Assignment tab. Make sure to accept the change by pressing Enter.

- Players are now be able to select their preferred clock acceleration factor from 2x to 5x, which could be useful when high factors make employees miss their pathing in certain layouts.

- Looking at storage boxes in shelves will now also make product information appear on the top-right corner.

- Added a new button in the game’s main menu for copying the game’s logs in the clipboard, this way players having a certain issue won’t have to copy it from the saves folder. It also removes some useless parts automatically.

- Fixed a collision issue while placing bamboo potted plants.

notes.title: Star Perks + Broom Skins
notes.content:
Greetings players, during last month the threshold of 10 million downloads was surpassed among more than 8,5 million unique users. The two members of this project wish you all a cozy new year.

Thanks for playing and here's a toast to a year hopefully full of constant updates and good brooming moments.

Changelog:
- Implemented a new kind of perks in the improvement blackboard called Star Perks, these will cost more than one franchise point and will feature advanced upgrades. So far, the following are available:
	* A perk that converts the trash container just outside into a recycling one.
	* A perk that updates the software in the pricing machine and introduces an option for it to automatically set all products pricing to the desired percentage.
	* A perk that makes time pass five times faster. Can only be triggered during nights when all customers have left the store and employees are busy in restocking or storage. Once acquired, a clock will appear in the manager’s room and players will be able to click on it to activate/deactivate the feature. If employees finish their restocking tasks it will deactivate by itself. This kind of time altering features may be expected troublesome, if issues are found feel free to post a topic about it.

- Implemented a skin system for brooms and the first five skins are rewards that can be acquired from a capsule machine in front of the supermarket that uses winter event’s rewards as coins. Some skins are rarer than others and their rarity is indicated by their respective star color in the broom-selecting machine (gold, silver and bronze).

- Players’ broom skin of choice can be set in a machine next to the capsule machines until a more refined way is developed. Skins are only visualized when a player is carrying them.

- Moderately increased the threshold for cashiers to level up as it was too fast. Players may notice a reduction in their cashiers’ grades.

- Cashiers leveling up will progressively decrease the time they take in checkouting products added to the time saves provided from perks. Note for now this will reach a cap inherent to how the game queues NPC tasks but it should be noticeable.

- Security crew leveling up will also make them progressively hit thieves faster.

- Employees will suffer a small speed penalty if they are not happy.

- Implemented a secondary way of managing stats, this could improve problems related to a few players crashing every new day.

- Implemented a system that will move old backups to an auxiliary folder in the save location, this way Steam Cloud won’t act wrong when trying to sync too many files (there’s a limit).

- Added a new setting in General options for hosts to automatically end the day if desired in case they want to go AFK in an online game.

- Adjusted potted sprout and potted bamboo decoration colliders so they can better overlap with other entities or the store.

- Fixed an issue related to thieves that made them drop the same product several times in a row instead of the actual list they stole.

- Limited opening and closing the store and buying space expansions to the manager’s role in multiplayer games.

- For better readability, unlock/require information fields in the perk’s blackboard will now display bigger if there’s only one field to show.

- Extended Winter event until day 8th for the stragglers and Minigrusches will always give a star token.

Have done some changes to employee’s code in preparation for next week optimizations like game’s freezing when employees are assigned but have nothing to do, better restocking and storage prioritization, or employees merging boxes contents when assigned to storage.

notes.title: Employees Rework: Part 1
notes.content:
Hello! This update features the first employee’s rework. As plenty of additions are new there could be issues that will be fixed these incoming days. Some other employee optimizations and features will be implemented next patch or the patch after.
In other news there might be a discount to the cool DLC quite soon for the incoming Steam Winter sales and more Christmas related stuff.

Changelog:
- Added two new employees.

- The employee’s blackboard next to the opening switch is now deprecated. Employees can now be hired, dismissed and assigned from the Manager’s blackboard. Each day a pool of 10 employees with different random stats will be generated, these stats are for now: cashier, restocking, storage management and security. These individual stats affect how fast they earn experience and it’s not an indicator of their performance.
* For commodity, players with ongoing games will be given the chance to reroll the employees’ pool once for every 5 ingame days played up to a capped max.

- Employees will earn experience when dedicated at their tasks: earning grades in the assigned task will make them more proficient at that particular task. Note that even an average employee will be more effective than all the ones from the previous system. Some initial improvements to each task depending on level for include:
* Cashiers: to be added soon, sensible suggestions are welcomed. 
* Restockers: will slowly earn extra moving speed (added to perks) and more importantly to mitigate restocking times they will be able to restock multiple items at once as they earn grades.
* Storage and security: will earn extra speed (added to perks) as they earn grades. Still thinking what improvement could storage employees benefit from, maybe being able to carry several boxes but its viability has to be studied.

- Tasks can now be assigned individually per employee via the Assignment tab in Manager’s blackboard.

- Employees have no collisions against themselves or other NPC entities to improve their pathing.

- Employees’ turning speed is now dependent on the speed upgrades perks for better navigation.

- Employees should now keep the same coherent positions outside when in security duty.

- Players can now name their employees when hiring and it will appear above their heads. This is optional and the input field can be left empty.

- In the case of DLC players, hats can be now assigned individually per employee in the Assignment tab. Joining players with permissions can also set the hats.

- Each employee has its own salary depending on their skills and some randomness. Players will be able to pay salary as invoices once the respective tab is operative in the Manager’s blackboard.

- Employees will now try to go to the staff room when not assigned. In the future the plan is for them to sit in placed chairs and stools if they exist.

- Improved customers pathing rotations, they should be now smoother than before.

- Changed the 100$ paper note in cash registers to a 50$ one.

- Further adjusted the small freezer and fixed an issue which made products protrude above glass.

- Added two more staffroom props: a stool and another arcade machine.

- Some changes to optimize restockers last week have been undone as players have reported some inefficiencies (high count products being restocked over low count). A better optimization is being worked on. Note that meanwhile players may get some FPS drops when restockers/storage are assigned (especially if ALL are assigned) and no products are available to be restocked or boxes to be transported, as they keep iterating and iterating over the high count of shelves for something to do.

Known issues: joining players may not see employee’s happiness level correctly.

notes.title: New Products And Snapping Patch
notes.content:
Changelog:

- 13 new products related to child care. Diapers, baby food, milk & milk powder, cleaning wipes, etc. Franchise perks are located parting from pharmacy.

- Added 3 modes of snapping in the builder (left control key by default, reassignable):
* Free mode: no snapping.
* Grid center: centers perfectly to grid and subgrid nodes. Useful for decoration, lights or anything that should be set every x distance.
* Furniture snap: snaps furniture together. Have to look at the side of the furniture players want to have their new prop snapped.
Note grid snapping is not that useful for big furniture placing and may implement a secondary mode that aligns props backside to the grid.

- Added a vertical array of icons for each tab in the Builder for better visual navigation.

- Widened the two doors that go from boxes spawn point to warehouse.

 - Products in boxes carried by employees or players should now be added up correctly to the total box counts in manager blackboard.

- Disabled most Halloween content excepting props and paintables.

- Have modified how saving game settings work as a previous step to allow Steam Cloud saving. If any player notices a game setting not saving successfully between sessions feel free to report.

- Replaced some icons in the perk’s blackboard for some more fitting ones.

- Players are now not able to delete the last manned checkout and will receive a warning.

- Fixed an issue in which trash would barely spawn in higher difficulties.

- Increased a few products count in boxes including toilet paper which goes from 6 to 8.

We are not forgetting most requested features among others: better vehicle handling, more employees and their customization, a more straight forward way of sync TVs content like Youtube, more permissions/roles variety, cloud saving activation, etc.

notes.title: Weekly patch - Builder rework
notes.content:
Hullo! There have been big changes related to the Builder and decoration tablet so make sure to check the logs below.

Changelog:
- Decoration tablets have been deprecated and all their contents moved to the Builder, which now features several tabs. Two new keys (Z and X) allow changing tabs, they can be reassigned in options to inputs of player’s convenience. This will help reorganizing items better when more arrive (a separate tab for lights, devices, decoration, etc.)

- An improvement related to previous point: decoration can now be moved with the builder instead of having to delete and rebuy it for repositioning.

- Deleting is now done from the builder in a new element just below Place Mode.

- Reworking the builder has now allowed being able to delete big furniture during nights but players will have to dispatch all customers first and wait until they leave the area. Currently the only way to do so was during mornings.

- Added 10 more expansions to the store to be acquired.

- Added an extra door for customer access along with its extra entrance space (available since Day 1).

- Since the auxiliar door left to the store was removed for new expansions, doors are now permanently opened for convenience.

- New additional furniture for produce, it’s less cumbersome than produce A and three of them should barely fit between pillars. Produce A can now have two stacks of most trays except artichokes to compensate its volume.

- Added a self-checkout furniture for 2500$. They won’t replace normal checkouts entirely as customers with a lot of items will not prefer them but they do help a lot nevertheless. As they are customer manned, they have a slower product checkout speed and there’s a tiny chance a product won’t be checked in (won’t affect statistics), chance that is increased with difficulty.

- The issue in the pre-patch where self-checkout wouldn’t count towards franchise experience and income should be solved.

- Improved customers shopping list pathing, they should be more efficient and do not roam the store so much which inherently means more customers per day.

- Dances and numpad keys required for pricing or credit card checkouting are now assignable in options (22 new assignments). Players using Numpad Plus for deleting values may have to reassign it in Controls.

- Improved certain behaviors performance, the FPS gain can be up to a 15% especially in the case of big stores.

notes.title: September Preparatory Patch
notes.content:
Greetings supermarket owners. This week has been mostly focused to prepare some core changes to network and saving system as this was a necessary pre-step for adding more perks or products and adding paint customization. We are also improving employees so apologies if they behave weirdly these days while we are tweaking them. Changelog:

- Added fourteen new employee related perks, they will probably change position in the blackboard as more stuff is added:
* Five perks for five additional employees.
* Three perks to have faster checkout speed.
* Two perks to have faster product placement
* Three perks to have even faster movement speed.
* One perk to have employees recycle boxes.

- Saving system has received core changes. Saving and loading should be way faster now and problems related to props missing in some saves should be mitigated as the game now access the data folder way less times.

- Day statistics won’t end automatically and will now wait for the host to press a key. Clients will have to wait for the host.

- Storage shelves will now remember the last product placed in them, that way employees will sort them accordingly. A label in each spot will show the product that was previously there. Spots can be cleared with the pricing tool the same way that with shelves.  (The issue present in the past weekend pre-patch where storage employees wouldn’t work should be gone).

- Employees will now prioritize restocking most empty shelves and keep iterating up to the more filled ones. In most cases several employees shouldn’t focus on the same shelf anymore.

- Employees should now go directly to another shelf if has products remaining in box instead of the current behavior in which they would return each time to storage box.

- The issue in which employees wouldn’t restock shelves until their full capacity should be fixed.

- Added a bamboo variation of the new potted spruce decoration plant.

- Added a history to chat text messages.

- Fixed an issue in which you could build or move new furniture inside decoration.

- Fixed an issue in which player’s speed was faster while moving in diagonal.

notes.content:
Hello! Changelog for this week:

* Kick players

notes.title: Weekly Patch Changelog
notes.content:
Thanks for your patience: apart from the feedback in forums and events logs we also receive lots of mails every day. In order to work in an organized way we’ll push the changelog around every Wednesday with few exceptions.

Changelog:
- Implementation of a new prop: the Basic Crowd Barrier, useful for redirecting the stream of those playful customers. Next public prop will be probably the door anti-theft beeping system.

- Game will now generate backups of your game per day, you can recover any last 10 days from the Load Store screen. Note that if up to this patch you had a corrupted save, the backups will be corrupted too sadly.

- Implemented changing difficulty on started games via the Load Store screen.

- Implemented being able to delete games via the Load Store screen.

- Customers have now a new internal system to place products in a faster way. It is really noticeable in advanced days.

- Looking at a shelf will now show some product’s info in the global interface, useful for shelves that previously contained products.

- Related to previous point, players can now totally reset a shelf’s product by pressing right click on it with the pricing item. A beep will confirm its success. This will make employees finally ignore shelves that players don’t want to be filled anymore.

- Reduced the pillars colliders just barely enough for 4 shelves to fit between them for perfectionist players.

- Extended the decoration boundaries to include the walkway in front of the store.

- Game will now wait for saving before returning to main menu or quitting the application. By analyzing saves some players sent as “bugged”, plenty of them seemed broken because quitting the game while saving OR they were overwritting a previous corrupted game. In any case backups are there to mitigate this issue.

- Walls between storage rooms have been demolished. Also reduced the width of the wall that separates storage from store so players might want to reposition their shelves.

- Butter now goes in fridges and is stackable vertically. If you have butter placed in shelves they might display incorrectly until you move them to a fridge.

- Fixed an issue in which players would move while in camera manager mode.

- Fixed an issue in which funds notifications would show as -0$.

- Fixed the products icons in the manager blackboard that showed Refrigerator instead of Freezer.

- Fixed an issue in which selecting hat ID 0 wouldn’t remove it.

- Modified some general values based on player’s progression feedback, including earning franchise points which is now faster at start and slower later.

- Fixed some products like the detergent or the big peas that wouldn’t face forward the shelf. There could be a few more.

- Added some more music tracks.


Extra news: 
- Hosts will notice that now Escape menu has a list with the rest of players, this is the precursor of the menu that will allow players to kick, punish friends and give a global use permission (will try to extend later to more particular permissions but this is more delicate to implement as the entire code has to be modified).
- Players having problems with saves will find tomorrow a new pinned topic with instructions about how to send logs and a sample Store File which can be downloaded for testing.
- If by next monday we haven’t heard replies from the propietary codecs owners to get the necessary license for TVs to work we’ll consider other options to at least hook the browser (we want this feature as much as you do).
Also DLC owners know that the arrival of the painting tablet is estimated during the first half of September. Exclusive props will arrive between patches here and there when possible.

PD: thanks to everybody that bought the support DLC, we have our daily jobs and this gives us some more resources to buy stuff to improve the game.

notes.title: Midweek patch + Hanging Banner prop
notes.content:
Hullo! Some of this features were added as smaller hotfixes during previous days. Remember it’s important for all players to keep the version of the game updated to last patch so there are no synchronization issues. There are some notifications about most reported issues at the end of the post.

Changelog:
- Added a new decoration: the Hanging Banner, you will be able to choose 15 different colors for it and set whatever text you want in it.

- [b]Important:[/b] related to previous point and since players will need keyboard for typing, to close the manager’s blackboard or the ceiling label menu players will now have to press escape or just press the newly created [X] button in interface. WASD won’t work anymore.

- Implemented the use of numpad for setting prices. Still have to modify tutorial to mention the feature.

- Players are now allowed to adjust FOV in options. Added a new volume slider as well to adjust TVs volume for the future. Fixed an issue in which a low FOV prevented correct manager’s blackboard visualization

- Thiefs will drop now more than 1 item per hit depending on the amount of total items stolen.

- Thiefs will no longer leave directly using the short path right to supermarket. They will roam around in the street outside a bit more.

- Reduced the chance of thievery for single player games, for more thieves you can inflate difficulty.

- Fixed an issue in which players could discover thieves before they would flee.

- Tutorial being stuck on clients should be solved now. Separate clients would still need to do certain steps so they don’t miss anything like taking a box or leaning to use the manager blackboard.

- Fixed an issue in which you could press the opening store button during nights to not avail but the notification popped up.

- Fixed an issue in which pressing P while chatting would open the escape menu.

- Minimized an issue in which you could have insane amounts of a product in a box.

- Fixed an issue in which some employees would go through some storage walls.

- Slightly adjusted given franchise experience down.

- Brightness correction while in the store during nights has been tweaked (a bit more bright)

- TVs no longer block players.

- Fixed an issue in which special perks like hiring an employee did not use a franchise point.

- Current day now shows in UI (the text right to current hour)

- Fixed an issue in which cursor would disappear if you pressed escape while navigating the manager’s blackboard.

- Fixed an issue in which player would get frame freezes when highlighting some furniture with the tablet.

- Fixed an issue in which refunding items would also get franchise experience.

We are aware of the main most reported issues:
1- That the state of public lobbies looks right now more like Mortal Kombat than a simulator. The tools for some control are in the making but they will require some time and testing on our side, for now there’s an unofficial Discord pinned in topics so you can get some buddies to do legal work with you.

2- Some issues of game not saving. Until we can pinpoint the exact issue we will implement some features to mitigate this, including generation of backups per day (you will be able to return to the day the game worked correctly and that will gives us better feedback as we will be able to compare a working file with its bugged counterpart).

3- Some few cases of game’s freezing when joining a store. While there could be some existing network problems that trigger with particular clients, always make sure that your external firewall or related security measures aren’t blocking the game’s communication with Steam.
The classic “Windows Firewall has blocked some features of this app” when you first run an application could make the game not being able to communicate with Steam for lobby synchronization.

notes.title: The weekend patch!
notes.content:
Hey ho! More fixes:
- Players can now delete furniture like shelves or checkouts from the tablet the same way they delete decoration. 90% of the cost will be refunded. Two important things:
* Can only sell furniture at 8pm before opening.
* For now contents inside containers will be DELETED. Make sure you empty shelves of products or storage of boxes before deleting. This will change and give you a warning in the future.

- Numpad can now be used to checkout with credit card. Including backspace, you can also use + and – to delete the input. (Setting prices with numpad coming soon).

- The speed at which now customers place items on checkout will be faster each new day until hitting a certain limit.

- Carried box is now moved to the side a bit when looking down, that way freezer’s products are visible.

- Important: Introduced a saving icon on new day so players know when to quit the game. This could alleviate some people’s problems because missing props probably due to disconnecting while saving.

- Fixed an issue in which acquiring an expansion would cost the next expansion’s price.

- Minimized the issue in which you could duplicate boxes by dropping and leaving it in a storage box or trying to recycle it for infinite money. Also to get a free item when you did the same to a shelf.

- Dropped boxes on ground will now appear oriented to the player.

- Removed the glitch in which you could quickly drop and take a box in order to try to duplicate it. Doing this now may result in being punished by losing the toy.

- Restockers NPCs should now refill shelves almost to the limit.

- Fixed in issue in which some players’ games would only show one public room in listings.

- Fixed an issue in which checkouts where sometimes not saved. Report if this happens again as it is a tricky point and  there may be other complementary causes. (We will probably have to ask for savegames to pinpoint it)

- Fixed an issue in which you could acquire some perks before acquiring the previous tree node, including employees.

- Fixed an issue in which franchise level would display in a wrong way in statistics screen and earned franchise experience would display a wrong value.

- Perks in blackboard now won’t show in unlockables the next nodes it unlocks since it was too obvious and led to misunderstandings. Also corrected some nodes showing LocError or wrong unlocked products (there could be some few more)

- Trying to get a joining code in a solo/private game will return something interesting now.

- Freezer in Builder now shows a better icon.

We have heard about your problem in public matches. Trolls will always troll no matter how limited their role is and host will not notice toxic behaviour until it’s too late. While we will attempt to give host some tools to deal with this, perhaps our efforts should be better placed in trying to gather people that wants to play seriously together so they let naughty people… outside.

Also the size of the new patch is to prepare the game for some content arriving during this week.

* Can only sell furniture at 8pm before opening.
* For now contents inside containers will be DELETED. Make sure you empty shelves of products or storage of boxes before deleting. This will change and give you a warning in the future.
Numpad can now be used to checkout with credit card. Including backspace, you can also use + and – to delete the input. (Setting prices with numpad coming soon).

tags.balance_change: The speed at which now customers place items on checkout will be faster each new day until hitting a certain limit.

tags.feature: Carried box is now moved to the side a bit when looking down, that way freezer’s products are visible.
Important: Introduced a saving icon on new day so players know when to quit the game. This could alleviate some people’s problems because missing props probably due to disconnecting while saving.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue in which acquiring an expansion would cost the next expansion’s price.

Minimized the issue in which you could duplicate boxes by dropping and leaving it in a storage box or trying to recycle it for infinite money. Also to get a free item when you did the same to a shelf.

tags.feature: Dropped boxes on ground will now appear oriented to the player.

tags.bug: Removed the glitch in which you could quickly drop and take a box in order to try to duplicate it. Doing this now may result in being punished by losing the toy.

tags.balance_change: Restockers NPCs should now refill shelves almost to the limit.

tags.bug: Fixed in issue in which some players’ games would only show one public room in listings.

Fixed an issue in which checkouts where sometimes not saved. Report if this happens again as it is a tricky point and  there may be other complementary causes. (We will probably have to ask for savegames to pinpoint it)
Fixed an issue in which you could acquire some perks before acquiring the previous tree node, including employees.
Fixed an issue in which franchise level would display in a wrong way in statistics screen and earned franchise experience would display a wrong value.

Perks in blackboard now won’t show in unlockables the next nodes it unlocks since it was too obvious and led to misunderstandings. Also corrected some nodes showing LocError or wrong unlocked products (there could be some few more)

tags.feature: Trying to get a joining code in a solo/private game will return something interesting now.
Freezer in Builder now shows a better icon.
